notes.title: 🏝️ Demo updated with bug fixes
notes.content:
Hey,

Pawnholm has a brand new demo for the Steam Next Fest June!
Watch this Let's play by Goony124 to explain some basic aspects of the game.

[i]In Pawnholm you control workers called pawns in randomly generated islands.
Craft, build, explore, and fight in RTS and colony sim-inspired gameplay.
And hopefully, make your kingdom prosper and develop![/i]

Latest demo hotfix v0.4.11 fixes include:
[list]
[*]Trait reveal notification kept popping up
[*]Pawns stopped working and stand still if no path was available
[/list]

It would mean a lot to me if you could try the demo!
- Hugimugi

tags.bug: Trait reveal notification kept popping up
